# temps_project_autofix_settings (Resource)

How the autofixer handles a project's new errors: whether it opens fixes, with which model, and which paths it must not touch.

Destroying the resource leaves the settings as they are.

Import with `<project_id>`.

Required API key permissions: `error_tracking:read`, `error_tracking:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_project_autofix_settings" "web" {
  project_id      = temps_project.web.id
  min_confidence  = 4
  protected_paths = ["migrations/**"]
  test_command    = "make test"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.

### Optional

- `ai_model` (String) Model; the provider default when unset.
- `ai_provider` (String) Model provider; the instance default when unset.
- `min_confidence` (Number) Lowest evidence score (`0`-`5`) a fix needs before autofix acts on it.
- `mode` (String) What the autofixer does, for example `off`, `suggest` or `pull_request`.
- `protected_paths` (List of String) Paths a fix must never change.
- `test_command` (String) Command that must pass before a fix is proposed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<project_id>`.
- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the autofixer is paused.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>
terraform import temps_project_autofix_settings.web 8
```
